data.name: Theatre of War: Rearmed
data.detailed_description:
Playtest is almost here. Join the forces now!

The playtest version offers a focused slice of the full experience.

It includes 11 missions across three campaigns (three missions each), along with 2 standalone scenarios. In addition, 9 tutorial missions are available to help you learn the core mechanics and systems.

Multiplayer is also supported, featuring 11 maps designed for tactical battles in both competitive and cooperative modes.


About the Game

Complete Collection

Theatre of War: Rearmed unites all entries in the series, along with their expansions, into one complete experience.

It includes Theatre of War with LEHR and Liberation Belarus, Theatre of War 2: Africa 1943 with Centauro, Theatre of War 2: Kursk 1943 with Battle for Caen, and Theatre of War 3: Korea.

The War, Reforged

Theatre of War: Rearmed brings the entire series together on the latest version of its original engine. All titles now share a common technical foundation, ensuring consistency across gameplay, controls, and interface.

Earlier entries have been brought up to the level of later titles, supported by engine optimizations and targeted improvements. Visuals feature updated shaders, lighting, and effects, the interface has been redesigned for high-resolution displays, and controls and camera behavior have been refined for modern expectations.

Each title now aligns with the technical and gameplay level of the final entry, creating a cohesive experience across all campaigns. This is not a new engine, but the original foundation — refined, improved, and brought to its most advanced form.

A War Across Fronts

From Europe to North Africa and beyond, the full scope of the series is now presented as a single, cohesive experience. Campaigns, standalone missions, and dynamic scenarios come together into a structure that supports both long, methodical playthroughs and shorter tactical engagements.

Depending on your approach, the game offers dozens of hours of gameplay, with enough variety to support multiple playstyles, from careful planning to aggressive execution.

Tactical Combat

At its core, Theatre of War is about control, precision, and understanding the battlefield.

Combat is built on realistic systems. Ballistics, armor penetration, and damage are calculated in detail. Vehicles respond to terrain, slope, and load, while crews rely on limited visibility and optics to detect threats. Infantry adapts to the situation, choosing firing positions and reacting to the environment in real time.

Systems and Replayability

Core systems have been revised and expanded to deliver a more consistent and readable battlefield. AI has been improved across all unit types, allowing infantry, vehicles, artillery, and aircraft to behave more predictably and effectively.

Command handling has been refined, giving you greater control over unit behavior, while engineering mechanics, visibility logic, and interaction systems have been expanded. Tanks can now repair, transport, and support in more flexible ways, and battlefield feedback has been improved without simplifying the underlying mechanics.

Beyond the core experience, the game remains open to experimentation. A mission and map editor allows you to create your own scenarios, while open resources and Workshop support make it possible to modify and expand the game further. Multiplayer has also been preserved and expanded, offering a wide range of maps and tactical possibilities for both competitive and cooperative play.

Key Features

  • Complete Theatre of War series unified on the latest version of its original engine

  • Over 100 missions across multiple campaigns and a dynamic strategic mode

  • Realistic tactical combat with advanced ballistics and damage systems

  • Improved AI across infantry, vehicles, artillery, and aircraft

  • Expanded gameplay systems including engineering, towing, and repairs

  • 64-bit upgrade with major performance and stability improvements

  • Enhanced visuals, lighting, shaders, and effects

  • Redesigned UI with full high-resolution support

  • Large multiplayer component with maps for up to 8 players

  • Mission generator for additional replayability

  • Full modding support with editor and open resources

  • Steam achievements

data.short_description: Command real-time WWII battles across the complete Theatre of War series, unified on the latest version of its original engine. Experience deep tactical combat, realistic ballistics, and over 100 missions, enhanced for modern systems.
data.supported_languages:
English*, Russian, German, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, French, Italian, Polish
*languages with full audio support
